description: This Java source file defines the AclValidator class in the Eclipse Ditto project, which validates Access Control Lists (ACLs) against minimum required permissions.

classes.name: AclValidator
classes.description: Implements validation logic for Access Control Lists (ACLs), ensuring they contain at least one Authorization Subject with specific permissions. Deprecated in favor of policy-based validation.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of AclValidator with the specified ACL and minimum required permissions.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Performs validation on the ACL to ensure it has at least one suitable Authorization Subject.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for validation failure, if any.
